text:
Eli: Heads-up, ZenithBank RFP wants SOC2, ISO scope excerpt, pen-test attestation, and a note on KMS separation. Deadline: Friday COB. Can we assemble a minimal evidence pack?
Tasha: We have SOC2 attestation PDF and control evidence links ready. ISO excerpt needs redaction (customer names + IPs). I can do redaction today.
Ravi: For the pen-test attestation, our vendor requires the counterparty name and a signature request email. How fast can Legal countersign?
legal: We can review the pen-test template within 24 hours if you tag the counterparty and share the proposed signer info. If they want a vendor-signed letter, add 48h for countersign.
oncall-bot: ops-schedule: next-week oncall is Mike Tue/Wed, Rerun scheduled windows: Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC, Thu 01:00-03:00 UTC.
Eli: Ask ZenithBank for the signatory and whether they will run external scans or want our pen-test vendor to perform tests. Also confirm residency requirement (they prefer EU-only infra).
Tasha: EU residency will likely push this to Private trial or Dedicated. Quote impact: private-week POC ~ $10k/week setup + provisioning. Hosted with IP allowlist could be offered as compromise, but call out data residency caveat.
Ravi: KMS question: they want tenant key separation and mention HSM. We can provide architecture diagram and KMS key policy excerpts. If they insist on customer-managed HSM, it's Private-tier.
Eli: Let's prepare: (1) SOC2+control matrix, (2) redacted ISO excerpt, (3) pen-test template + note on countersign timeline, (4) KMS architecture diagram + short HSM readiness note, (5) Ops scan-runbook and available windows.
Tasha: I'll drop SOC2 and ISO excerpt into the dataroom and attach a README listing exact control IDs.
Ravi: I'll paste the pen-test template and a one-line HSM readiness statement. Legal: tagging you when I drop the template.
legal: Received. Will prioritize review when signer info is provided.
oncall-bot: ops-note: prefer Thu 01:00-03:00 UTC for minimal disruption, confirm channel #prod-scans for live comms.
Eli: Great. I'll email ZenithBank with dataroom link, ask for signer name/email, propose Thu window, and include both deployment options with pricing/lead-times.
Tasha: Uploaded: zenith-evidence-2026.zip (SOC2.pdf, control-matrix.csv, iso-excerpt-redacted.pdf). Presigned link expires in 7 days.
Eli: Thanks — sending now. :email:
